title: Lingashtakam
author: Traditional
intro: Eight verses in praise of the Shiva linga, each ending with the refrain तत्प्रणमामि सदाशिवलिङ्गम्, 'I bow to that linga of Sadashiva', followed by a closing verse. One of the most widely sung hymns in daily Shiva puja.
note: Eight verses, each ending with the same refrain, followed by a closing verse.
